purpose: Teach: 見舞わ/陥り/放つ/つながら/かけ離れ/一転/産む/傷つける

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが急用に見舞われてお出かけよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad had to leave suddenly for something urgent.
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact delivery. Soft opening. Quiet acceptance in the voice—not dramatic, just stating what is. Warm enough that Sho doesn't feel abandoned by the news.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、勉強で疲れに陥りそうだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm worried I'm going to get worn out from studying.
lines.style: Small, quiet voice with an undertone of genuine concern, not complaining. Hesitant phrasing—testing if it's okay to admit this. A child being honest about feeling small.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが優しい言葉を放つ瞬間があるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has moments where he says really kind things to you.
lines.style: Reassuring but not dismissive of his worry. Speaking from observation, not platitude. Slight warmth underneath—she's reminding him of something true he might forget when he's tired.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんと電話がつながらない時もあるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, sometimes I can't get through to Dad on the phone.
lines.style: Quiet admission. Not accusatory—just stating a small hurt. The vulnerability of a child who notices gaps between people he loves.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、現実がイメージとかけ離れる事もあるわ
lines.en: Sho, sometimes reality doesn't match what we hoped it would be.
lines.style: Soft, understanding tone. Speaking from her own experience, not lecturing. A pause before the sentence—gathering the right words. Trailing off slightly, letting him sit with the truth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんが帰宅されて気分が一転したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad came home and everything just changed.
lines.style: Brightness breaking through. A small boy's relief and joy rising in his voice. Still controlled—he's not shouting—but genuine warmth underneath. The lightness of a worry lifting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお魚が卵を産む話を聞かせて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told you about fish spawning eggs.
lines.style: Warm, almost playful recollection. A small smile in the voice—she's remembering the moment he came home lighter. Soft focus, like watching him listen to his father.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんを傷つける事絶対しないって誓うよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm never going to hurt Dad. I promise.
lines.style: Solemn, young voice full of serious intent. No hesitation—absolute conviction. The kind of oath a child makes when love feels fragile and he wants to protect it fiercely.
